name: GithubActionBuilder

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      kernel_repo:
        description: 'owner/repo kernel source'
        required: true
        default: 'JeanneDarc-star/OSK'
      kernel_branch:
        description: 'Branch kernel yang mau di-build'
        required: true
        default: 'Sarkazz-OC'
      defconfig:
        description: 'Nama defconfig (relatif ke arch/<ARCH>/configs/)'
        required: true
        default: 'earth_defconfig'
      ksu_ref:
        description: 'Arg ke KernelSU (backslashxx fork) setup.sh, kosong = default branch'
        required: false
        default: ''
      arch:
        description: 'Target arch'
        required: true
        default: 'arm64'

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    env:
      KDIR: kernel_src
      ARCH: ${{ github.event.inputs.arch }}
      CLANG_URL: https://android.googlesource.com/platform/prebuilts/clang/host/linux-x86/+archive/c66f8b376703f420d791cf01547d076649651aa8/clang-r614150.tar.gz
      ANYKERNEL_REPO: https://github.com/JeanneDarc-star/AnyKernel3.git
      KSU_SETUP_URL: https://github.com/backslashxx/KernelSU/raw/refs/heads/master/kernel/setup.sh
    steps:
      - name: Checkout kernel source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: ${{ github.event.inputs.kernel_repo }}
          ref: ${{ github.event.inputs.kernel_branch }}
          path: ${{ env.KDIR }}
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Validasi kernel version = 4.19
        working-directory: ${{ env.KDIR }}
        run: |
          V=$(grep -m1 '^VERSION = ' Makefile | awk '{print $3}')
          P=$(grep -m1 '^PATCHLEVEL = ' Makefile | awk '{print $3}')
          echo "Detected kernel version: ${V}.${P}"
          if [ "$V" != "4" ] || [ "$P" != "19" ]; then
            echo "::error::Workflow ini cuma support kernel 4.19, source ini ${V}.${P}"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Install build deps
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y bc bison flex cpio libssl-dev \
            libelf-dev dwarves zstd lz4 python3 git curl zip \
            gcc-aarch64-linux-gnu gcc-arm-linux-gnueabi

      - name: Fetch clang toolchain
        run: |
          mkdir -p clang
          curl -Ls "$CLANG_URL" | tar -C clang -xzf -
          echo "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/clang/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      - name: Verify toolchain
        run: |
          clang --version
          ld.lld --version

      - name: Integrate KernelSU
        working-directory: ${{ env.KDIR }}
        run: |
          curl -LSs "$KSU_SETUP_URL" | bash -s ${{ github.event.inputs.ksu_ref }}
          test -d drivers/kernelsu || { echo "KSU inject gagal, drivers/kernelsu tidak ada"; exit 1; }

      - name: Enable full LTO
        working-directory: ${{ env.KDIR }}
        run: |
          CFG="arch/${ARCH}/configs/${{ github.event.inputs.defconfig }}"
          test -f "$CFG" || { echo "defconfig tidak ditemukan: $CFG"; exit 1; }
          sed -i '/CONFIG_LTO_CLANG_THIN/d;/CONFIG_LTO_CLANG_FULL/d;/^CONFIG_LTO_CLANG=/d;/^# CONFIG_LTO_CLANG is not set/d' "$CFG"
          printf '%s\n' \
            'CONFIG_LTO_CLANG=y' \
            'CONFIG_LTO_CLANG_FULL=y' \
            '# CONFIG_LTO_CLANG_THIN is not set' >> "$CFG"

      - name: Build kernel
        working-directory: ${{ env.KDIR }}
        env:
          DEFCONFIG: ${{ github.event.inputs.defconfig }}
        run: |
          MAKE_ARGS="LLVM=1 LLVM_IAS=1 CROSS_COMPILE_ARM32=arm-linux-gnueabi-"
          KCFLAGS="-O3 -Wno-error"

          make -j"$(nproc)" O=out ARCH="$ARCH" $MAKE_ARGS KCFLAGS="$KCFLAGS" "$DEFCONFIG"
          make -j"$(nproc)" O=out ARCH="$ARCH" $MAKE_ARGS KCFLAGS="$KCFLAGS" 2>&1 | tee build.log

      - name: Package with AnyKernel3
        run: |
          mkdir -p artifacts
          git clone --depth=1 "$ANYKERNEL_REPO" AnyKernel3
          cp "${KDIR}"/out/arch/"${ARCH}"/boot/Image* AnyKernel3/ 2>/dev/null || true
          find "${KDIR}"/out/arch/"${ARCH}"/boot/dts -name '*.dtb' -exec cat {} + > AnyKernel3/dtb 2>/dev/null || true
          cd AnyKernel3
          zip -r9 "../artifacts/kernel-${{ github.event.inputs.kernel_branch }}-ksu-anykernel3.zip" . -x '.git*'
          cd ..
          cp "${KDIR}"/build.log artifacts/ 2>/dev/null || true

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: kernel-${{ github.event.inputs.kernel_branch }}-ksu
          path: artifacts/*
          retention-days: 14
